title: The Lord of the Flies
author: William Golding
current_text: The Lord of the Flies was challenged at Owen High School in North Carolina in 1981 because it was considered “demoralizing inasmuch as it implies that man is little more than an animal.”

sources.quote: “Lord of the Flies” by William Golding, challenged at Owen High School in North Carolina in 1981 because it was “demoralizing inasmuch as it implies that man is little more than an animal.”
